metadata.description:
The Capella Tower is more than just one of the tallest buildings in the state—it’s a symbol of Minneapolis’s blend of art and industry. Its curved crown and skyway connections make it instantly recognizable and unusually elegant for a skyscraper. This tower shows that even corporate architecture can have a little soul. You’ve unlocked this Architecture Aficionado POAP in the 612 POAP Challenge by admiring modern height with a twist. 

Category: Architecture Aficionado 
GPS: 44.97637, -93.2686
